shared_elements: tall upright monolithic stone block carved in low relief
horizontal band/register across the upper part of the shaft
paired curving arc/limb-like elements descending on the front face
raised rectangular/loop-shaped motifs in the upper zone
broad flat frontal face used as a carving field
justification: Both are tall frontal stone monoliths whose broad face is divided into an upper zone of discrete motifs (loop/rectangular forms, a horizontal patterned band) above a lower shaft bearing curving arc-like elements and a disc, which is a genuinely comparable compositional scheme. The decisive difference is in execution and content: A is a rounded, volumetric figure with a modelled head bearing eyes and ears and heavy sculptural relief, while B is a flat-faced slab with shallow, linear animal imagery (quadruped, birds, snake-like forms) and no face at all.
